name: PureDocBench
description: PureDocBench is a source-driven document parsing benchmark with 1,475 annotated pages across 10 domains and 66 fine-grained subcategories. Each page has aligned clean, digital-degraded, and real-degraded image tracks for OCR and document parsing evaluation.

distribution.name: release_manifest_1475.csv
distribution.description: Official page-level manifest for the 1,475-page PureDocBench release. The manifest is included in the full release archive and mirrored with the release materials.

distribution.name: pdb_full.tar.part-000 ... pdb_full.tar.part-009
distribution.description: Full dataset release as a split tar archive. Download all 10 parts plus SHA256SUMS.txt from the Kaggle page, verify with shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt, then reconstruct with cat pdb_full.tar.part-* | tar -xf -. Contains GT JSON, HTML sources, clean images, digital-degraded images, real-degraded images, manifests, and documentation. The sha256 value records the checksum of the reconstructed tar stream after concatenating the 10 split parts in lexical order.

distribution.name: SHA256SUMS.txt
distribution.description: SHA256 checksum manifest for the 10 full split archive parts.

distribution.name: puredocbench-v1.0-sample
distribution.description: Representative sample containing one official page from each of the 66 subcategories.

recordSet.name: pages
recordSet.description: One record per official PureDocBench page. Each record links the GT JSON, HTML source, clean image, digital-degraded image, and real-degraded image.

rai:dataCollection: PureDocBench is synthetically generated. Document HTML/CSS sources are generated from document-type prompts, rendered into images, and used as hidden annotation anchors. The benchmark does not scrape or redistribute real documents.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw assets are synthetic HTML/CSS source documents, rendered document images, and controlled visual degradation outputs derived from the same page identities.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML/CSS pages are rendered into clean document images.
Digitally degraded images are generated from the clean renders.
Real-degraded images are produced under controlled physical or capture conditions.
GT JSON annotations are extracted from the source-driven page representation and checked against expected schema and pairing constraints.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are source-driven page-level labels covering text blocks, titles, tables, table captions, formulas, figure captions, code, references, headers, footers, page numbers, and reading order metadata.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Custom HTML/CSS rendering and annotation extraction pipeline
rai:annotationsPerItem: One source-driven GT JSON file per official page, with additional validation and review.
rai:dataUseCases: Testing and benchmarking OCR and document parsing systems.
Evaluating robustness across clean, digital-degraded, and real-degraded document images.
Studying recovery of text, tables, formulas, and reading order.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is synthetic and may not capture all variability of real documents.
The dataset should not be used for decisions about real people, finances, healthcare, legal status, education, employment, or benefits.
Fictional names, IDs, addresses, or record-like values may appear in synthetic documents and should not be treated as real records.
rai:dataBiases: The distribution reflects the prompt taxonomy, template design, rendering engine, and selected degradation profiles.
Chinese, English, and mixed Chinese-English documents are represented, but global language and institutional coverage is incomplete.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No real personal documents are intentionally included. Some synthetic documents imitate sensitive domains such as finance, medical, legal/government, logistics, and certificates using fictional record-like fields.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to improve transparency and reproducibility in document parsing evaluation. Risks include over-interpreting synthetic content as real records or using benchmark performance as a proxy for safe deployment in sensitive real-world workflows.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The public release is versioned as puredocbench-v1.0. Corrections should be released as new versions with changelogs, manifest diffs, and updated Croissant metadata. The public release is maintained through the GitHub repository and Hugging Face dataset page.
